attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (console) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The binary is a 64-bit Windows console utility designed to parse command-line arguments and prompt a user for input. Its behavior is consistent with the standard Windows `choice.exe` tool. Key functions like `wmain`, `ProcessCMDLine`, and `GetChoice` handle command-line parsing and console I/O (`GetStdHandle`, `ReadConsoleW`, `WriteConsoleW`). Embedded strings such as `<description>Offers the user a choice</description>` and command-line option processing for switches like `/C`, `/N`, `/T`, and `/?` confirm its purpose as a benign interactive utility. No malicious IOCs or behaviors were identified.
